nixpkgs.description: Pinned nixpkgs channel. Verify every nixos option and package exists here before use.

nixos-containers.description: containers.<name> module (systemd-nspawn) options — the architecture runs ALL services as NixOS containers.

snm.description: Simple NixOS Mailserver (GitLab): accounts (renamed from loginAccounts), aliases, sieveScript, x509 certs, Resend relay workaround.

disko.description: Disko partitioning and ZFS layout definitions.

sops-nix.description: sops-nix secrets management: secrets.yaml, age keys, module options.

nixos-anywhere.description: Remote NixOS install and deployment tooling.

vpn-confinement.description: Network-namespace VPN confinement for qBittorrent, SABnzbd, slskd.

nixarr.description: NixOS media stack module (nix-media-server/nixarr) — arrs, Jellyfin, downloaders, VPN. Useful patterns for the media containers.

mcp-nixos.description: The nixos MCP server (uvx mcp-nixos): searches 130K+ packages, 23K+ options, Home Manager, wiki, noogle, nix.dev, flakehub, binary cache. Use to verify any option/package against real NixOS data before writing.
